column2: PRIVACY FIGURES AND TEXT-WALL VISUALS. tests/reveal.spec.ts fails any section over 300 characters that has nothing to look at, and two sections currently fail. That is the Slingshot 2/10 anti-reference (design-refs/strips/Slingshot_Scroll.png): 'all thats on the screen is block text and words with no diagrams, people or ambience'. Give each failing section something to look at, sized so it still composes within one viewport. For PRIVACY specifically the founder asked for people: anonymised figures with blurred or unresolved faces that SHOW the no-tracking claim rather than asserting it in prose. Reuse the volumetric GhostFigure idiom already in the Outputs section rather than inventing a second one; design-refs/strips/Playvision_People_Movement.png is the 10/10 reference for figures with data bound to them. §5 is absolute - no facial detail may EVER resolve. Take a different approach from the other candidates on what each section's visual is and how the privacy figures are composed.

SELECTOR REFINEMENTS - refine the merged entry view, do not rebuild it. Three founder notes against design-refs/strips/Clary_Selector.png (10/10): (a) the small tiles/markers beside 'Museums & Galleries' and 'Gyms' are currently identical and must visually differentiate the two verticals; (b) the reference uses a WHITE ground for the entry screen and ours is black - switch to the light ground, which also makes the fade into the dark hero a stronger transition; (c) mirror the reference more closely in general - pill geometry, the weight and position of the question, the drift path to the top right. Keep testids vertical-selector, select-museums, select-gyms, and keep hero-tab-museums / hero-tab-gyms working.

REDUCED MOTION - close the last standing red floor. Under prefers-reduced-motion the page must be static and complete: zero running Web Animations, an idle canvas whose screenshot hash does not change over 500ms, and all key content reachable by plain scroll. Read the SCOPE note in DESIGN.md §5 first - the distinction is AMBIENT vs INTERACTION. Idle and ambient motion must freeze, INCLUDING the new ambient field and the venue wireframe; user-initiated response (hover or tap driving the attention and utilisation timers) is interaction feedback and must KEEP working. Killing the demos to pass this is a §3 protected-element failure, not a fix. Every scroll reveal must render in its FINAL revealed state, fully readable - tests/reveal.spec.ts still applies.
